courses.title: Technical Writing and Communication in Computer Science
courses.reason: REFUTED ON TITLE; units confirmed. The claimed title 'Technical Writing for Computer Science and Engineering' is CSE 185E's title, not CSE 185S's own title, and the cited source_url is a CSE 185E page (a different course code). I verified the claim's negative evidence: /upper-division/cse-185s returns HTTP 404 on BOTH the 2025-2026 edition and the 'current' edition, so there is genuinely no standalone 2025-2026 entry. However, every source that titles 185S itself gives a different string: the UCSC Baskin Engineering course page (https://courses.engineering.ucsc.edu/courses/cse185S) reads 'Technical Writing and Communication in Computer Science', Credits 5; the year-pinned 2019-2020 catalog page (https://catalog.ucsc.edu/en/2019-2020/general-catalog/courses/cse-computer-science-and-engineering/upper-division/cse-185s) reads identically, Credits 5. The claim's own note flagged this exact risk and then stored the 185E string anyway, which is a title error under the code CSE 185S. Contradiction worth recording: a WebSearch summary asserted 185S carries the 185E title, but that is a search-engine conflation of the two cross-listed codes -- no page I actually fetched supports it. The cited 185E page does serve 2025-2026 and does state 'Credits 5', and 5 units holds on every edition checked, so the unit value is safe; only the title is wrong.
courses.note: CROSS-LISTED, NO STANDALONE ENTRY IN 2025-2026. The code is live and carries 5 units, but it has no page of its own this edition: /upper-division/cse-185s returns HTTP 404, and the department course index runs '... CSE 184, CSE 185C, CSE 185E, CSE 186 ...' with no 185S. It is published instead inside the CSE 185E entry, which reads 'Also offered as CSE 185S', lists 'Cross Listed Courses: CSE 185S', states 'Credits 5', and carries a second prerequisite block headed 'Also offered as CSE 185S' restricted to computer science majors (prereq CSE 101 + one additional upper-division CSE course). CAUTION ON TITLE: the 2025-2026 catalog prints no separate title for 185S, so the title given here is the shared cross-list title from the 185E entry. Under its own former standalone entry the title differed: the year-pinned 2019-20 page (https://catalog.ucsc.edu/en/2019-2020/general-catalog/courses/cse-computer-science-and-engineering/upper-division/cse-185s) titled it 'Technical Writing and Communication in Computer Science', Credits 5 (formerly CMPS 185). Units are 5 on every edition checked, so the unit value is safe regardless of which title you store.
